artboards.title: Project page · Hometown Coloring Book (template for the rest)

annotations.text:
Round 4 — the dark direction, as a site.

Home is the dark homepage from round 3. Next to it: the Fantasy Joes case study, a project page for an archived project (Hometown, the template every other project page follows), and the Updates index.

The game capture is re-shot with the preview-only Duel/Rankings pill hidden in CSS, so the header's right edge and X button are exactly as the app renders them; nothing is painted over.

Still two stand-ins: Recess (wordmark rebuilt in HTML) and Aura (suit Pepe from the Aura repo). This session runs in a cloud container and cannot see your Mac's Downloads or Desktop. To get the real files in: add them to the nickdahlhoff-site repo (GitHub → Add file → Upload) as public/images/recess/logo.png and public/images/aura/hourglass.jpg, and I'll pull them into both the canvas and the build.
